metadata.title: आदिवासी ज्ञान और ट्राइबल स्टडी में तालमेल | Tribal Knowledge and tribal studies must be connected
metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat recently covered an important conference focused on establishing a structured syllabus and research methodology for Tribal Studies, a field gaining increasing academic interest across universities and institutions. The event was attended by key figures in education, including the Minister for Higher Education, Inder Singh Parmar. In an exclusive interview, the Minister shared insights on the government's plans to formalize and expand Tribal Studies, highlighting the importance of preserving and promoting indigenous knowledge systems. Watch this insightful conversation to learn more about the future of Tribal Studies in India's higher education landscape.
